body:
## Outcome

Reuse one approved brand/icon asset system without adding a large icon catalog or duplicating logo geometry.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P1 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Reuse the existing brand mark geometry and evaluate the Bloxwap icons repository and current Lucide usage as audited sources.
- Define approved icons, stroke, size, alignment, filled/stroked usage, color, labels, decorative semantics, and RTL mirroring rules.
- Provide lightweight React SVG and RN SVG/native renderers plus docs/OG/favicons from the same approved sources.
- Keep icons tree-shakable and brand assets versioned; preserve attribution and avoid bundling fonts or full icon libraries by default.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Web and native examples match approved geometry and visual sizing at the defined sizes.
- [ ] Decorative icons and interactive icon buttons have correct accessibility treatment and touch/focus target geometry.
- [ ] Consumers can import a single mark/icon without importing a full icon set; generated assets have provenance and drift checks.

## Prerequisites

- #10 — Establish accessibility, localization, and platform behavior standards

## References

- [Tokens](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/tokens)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Hyperliquid](https://github.com/bloxwap/hyperliquid/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Standardize Bloxwap brand marks and icon usage across web/native
